functions.name: ai.attack
functions.doc: Starts one of the creature's attacks (creatures.define{attacks = {...}}) at a target (default: its own). The attack's animation starts now on every client and the hit is decided `windup` seconds later: melee strikes what is still within reach and arc, ranged fires its projectile. False when the attack is cooling down, out of range, or another one is under way.

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.can_see
functions.doc: Whether the creature sees a player or entity now (range, field of view, line of sight).

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.chase
functions.doc: Closes in on a player, an entity or a point (planning around terrain). Options: distance (stop this close, default 1.5), run (default true).

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.cooldown
functions.doc: Seconds until an attack or ability is ready (0 when it is).

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.fire
functions.doc: Fires a projectile from the creature's eyes at a target, outside its attacks (no windup, no cooldown). Options: damage_scale, lead (default true).

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.flee
functions.doc: Runs away from a player, entity or point for `seconds` (default 4).

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.forget
functions.doc: Makes a creature forget a player or entity (and stop chasing it).

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.go_home
functions.doc: Walks back to its home (where it spawned, or ai.set_home).

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.hunt
functions.doc: Runs one step of the built-in hunter for this creature: chase or keep its distance, surround with its pack, use whichever attack fits, flee when hurt, return home past its leash, investigate what it heard, wander. Call it from a state's tick to borrow the default behaviour.

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.join_pack
functions.doc: Puts a creature in another's pack (creatures spawned together by a spawn rule, or with entities.spawn{pack = other}, already are): packs share what they notice, surround a target together, and info.pack_hurt tells a brain how badly the pack is doing.

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

params.name: other
params.doc: A member of the pack to join.

functions.name: ai.keep_distance
functions.doc: Stays between `distance` and `far` blocks of a target (what archers do), facing it.

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.known
functions.doc: What a creature knows of: every target it saw or heard and still remembers.

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

returns.doc: {target, position, visible, hostile, threat, seen (seconds ago)} entries.

functions.name: ai.move_to
functions.doc: Walks (flies, swims) to a point. Options: run (default false).

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.noise
functions.doc: Makes a noise creatures may hear: those within hearing * loudness / 16 blocks remember it (and who made it, given a player or entity). The game makes noises itself: gunshots (32), explosions (48), digging and building (8).

params.name: source
params.doc: The player or entity that made it.

functions.name: ai.pack
functions.doc: The members of a creature's pack (itself included), leader first.

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.phase
functions.doc: A boss's phase: 0 before the first threshold, then 1, 2, ...

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.ready
functions.doc: Whether an attack or ability has cooled down.

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.remember
functions.doc: Makes a creature aware of a player or entity (as if it had heard it), hostile unless options.hostile is false. Options: threat (default 1).

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.set_home
functions.doc: Sets the point a creature returns to (and its leash's centre).

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.set_scale
functions.doc: Scales a creature's speed and damage from now on (boss phases do this too).

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.set_state
functions.doc: Switches a creature's brain to a state (its exit and the new state's enter run).

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.set_target
functions.doc: Sets whom a creature is after (nil: nobody); entity.target_changed fires. It keeps the target until it loses it (memory) or something far more threatening appears.

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

params.name: target
params.doc: A player, an entity, or nil.

functions.name: ai.set_water
functions.doc: Where swimmers find water: open cells whose centre is below `level` (default 1.5, the Lagoon's sea) in the listed biomes (default {"lagoon"}; "*" for every biome).

functions.name: ai.state
functions.doc: A creature's current brain state.

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.stats
functions.doc: AI load since the session started: thoughts, deferred thoughts, planning, time spent.

returns.doc: {minds, thinks, deferred, think_ms, step_ms, paths, nodes, fields, cache_hits, sight_checks, projectiles}.

functions.name: ai.stop
functions.doc: Stops moving (the brain keeps thinking).

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.surround
functions.doc: Takes this creature's slot in a ring around the target (its pack spreads out evenly).

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.target
functions.doc: Whom a creature is after.

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

returns.doc: A player or entity, or nil.

functions.name: ai.threat
functions.doc: Adds to (or, negative, takes from) how threatening a creature finds a target.

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.use
functions.doc: Uses one of the creature's abilities (creatures.define{abilities = {x = {cooldown, range, windup, animation, run = function(entity, target)}}}): after its windup, `run` is called. False while it cools down or another attack is under way.

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: ai.wander
functions.doc: Strolls to a random point within `radius` (default 8) of its home.

params.name: entity
params.doc: An entity whose creature has AI.

functions.name: assets.exists
functions.doc: Whether an asset is present in any enabled mod ("@mod/name" pins one).

functions.name: assets.list
functions.doc: Files directly in an asset folder, across every enabled mod.

functions.name: atmosphere.push
functions.doc: Adds an atmosphere layer that blends over the game's own: sky_zenith, sky_horizon, fog_color, ambient, sun_color, ambient_intensity, sun_intensity, fog_start, fog_end, exposure (EV), bloom, saturation, contrast, temperature, vignette, lut ("luts/name"), lut_strength; region {min=, max=} or {center=, radius=} with feather; priority, fade_in, fade_out, strength.

functions.name: atmosphere.remove
functions.doc: Fades a layer out and removes it (immediate=true: now).

functions.name: atmosphere.set
functions.doc: Replaces a layer's values (it keeps its fade).

functions.name: atmosphere.weight
functions.doc: How strongly a layer applies now (fade times region, 0..1).

functions.name: blocks.define
functions.doc: Defines a mod block. `fallback` (a retail block) is what the world, the save and every stock message hold; the identity and presentation live in the mod layer. Fields: name, fallback, texture, faces = {top, side, bottom}, model, light (0-15), drops (loot table, item, or "none"), drop_count, liquid (true: water-like - no collision, swum in, passed by the crosshair, drawn translucent; its fallback must let light through, e.g. ice).

functions.name: blocks.get
functions.doc: A mod block's definition.

returns.doc: {key, name, fallback, texture, model, light, liquid} or nil.

functions.name: blocks.list
functions.doc: Every mod block key.

functions.name: brains.define
functions.doc: Defines a brain: a state machine creatures run on the server (creatures.define{brain = name}). `states` maps each state's name to {enter, tick, exit, damaged, heard, noticed} callbacks, each called as (entity, info); `tick` (and the others) may return the name of the state to switch to. A state may also be just a function (its tick). `initial` is the first state (default: the first one). info = {dt, state, time (seconds in this state), target, target_position, target_distance, sees_target, health, max_health, health_fraction, position, home, home_distance, pack_size, pack_hurt (0..1 of the pack's health lost), leader, phase, attacking, known, heard (where it last heard something), data}; damaged adds amount and attacker, heard adds noise, noticed adds noticed.

functions.name: camera.clear
functions.doc: Ends every shake, pulse and fade at once.

functions.name: camera.fade
functions.doc: Fades a full-screen colour over the world (under the HUD) to `alpha` over `seconds`.

functions.name: camera.fov_pulse
functions.doc: Widens (or with a negative value narrows) the view by `degrees` and back over `seconds`. None with Reduced motion.

functions.name: camera.shake
functions.doc: Shakes the view: strength 0..1, seconds, frequency (Hz). Scaled by the player's Explosion camera shake setting; none with Reduced motion.

functions.name: commands.register
functions.doc: Registers a chat command. `/name args` calls fn(player, args, line); a string it returns is shown to that player. /help lists every mod command.

functions.name: creatures.define
functions.doc: Defines a creature or NPC. Fields: name, model, texture, health (retail enemy units: a pistol round is about 1), speed, run_speed, damage (player health, 100 = full), attack_range, attack_cooldown, view_range, size = {width, height}, behaviour (passive, neutral, hostile, npc), drops, interact, dialogue, show_name, spawn = {biomes, light_min, light_max, time (day/night/any), surface, chance, max, group_min, group_max, y_min, y_max}. AI (any of these makes it an AI creature, docs/modding/authoring.md): brain (a brains.define key; none = the built-in hunter), team, hostile_to, friends, senses = {sight, fov, hearing, memory, xray}, movement (ground, fly, swim, amphibious, or {mode, jump, fall, climb, height, swim_speed}), attacks = {name = {type = melee|ranged, reach | range, min_range, arc, damage, creature_damage, cooldown, windup, recovery, animation, projectile, spread, count, lead, weight}}, abilities = {name = {cooldown, range, windup, animation, run}}, boss = {title, color, music, range, arena, phases = {{below, name, state, music, speed, damage}}}, think_rate, leash, flee_health, pack_flee, surround. A `model` of "retail:zombie" (skeleton, archer, skeleton_axes, skeleton_sword, felguard, alien) wears that retail enemy from the player's own game, where it is installed.

functions.name: creatures.list
functions.doc: Every creature key.

functions.name: dialogue.choose
functions.doc: Answers the dialogue shown to the local player (1-based).

functions.name: dialogue.close
functions.doc: Closes a player's dialogue.

functions.name: dialogue.current
functions.doc: The dialogue node shown to the local player.

returns.doc: {session, title, speaker, text, portrait, choices} or nil.

functions.name: dialogue.define
functions.doc: Defines a dialogue tree: {title, start, nodes = {name = {speaker, text, portrait, next, on_enter = fn(player, node), choices = {{text, next, condition = fn(player) -> bool, action = fn(player), start_quest}}}}}. A creature with `dialogue` opens it when talked to.

functions.name: dialogue.open
functions.doc: Opens a dialogue for a player: {node, entity}.

functions.name: difficulty.get
functions.doc: The scaling in effect.

functions.name: difficulty.reset
functions.doc: Back to the game's own difficulty.

functions.name: difficulty.set
functions.doc: Scales retail enemies for everyone in the session: health, the damage they deal and how fast they spawn. Applied by every peer to the enemies it simulates. `types` overrides the health scale per enemy class (zombie, archer, skeleton, felguard, alien); damage is scaled for all classes alike.

functions.name: effects.apply
functions.doc: Applies an effect: {duration (seconds; omit for until removed), strength, stat, stack}. Re-applying refreshes it unless stack is true.

functions.name: effects.define
functions.doc: Defines a status effect: {interval, icon, start = fn(player, strength), tick = fn(player, strength), stop = fn(player, strength)}. Built in: speed (strength = movement multiplier), regen and damage (health per second), stat (moves `stat` by strength per second).

functions.name: effects.has
functions.doc: Whether an effect is active.

functions.name: effects.list
functions.doc: A player's active effects.

functions.name: effects.mine
functions.doc: The local player's effects, as replicated.

functions.name: effects.remove
functions.doc: Removes an effect.

functions.name: enemies.allowed
functions.doc: Whether the rules let a retail enemy family appear at a position.

params.name: family
params.doc: zombie, skeleton, archer, felguard, alien, dragon, spawner or hell.

functions.name: enemies.get_rules
functions.doc: The retail enemy rules in effect (the host's, on a client).

returns.doc: {active, enabled, families = {zombie = true, ...}, distance = {scale, offset, max}, regions, clear_existing}.

functions.name: enemies.reset
functions.doc: Back to the retail enemies, exactly as the game spawns them.

functions.name: enemies.rules
functions.doc: Rules for the RETAIL enemies of the whole session (every peer spawns its own player's enemies; every peer applies these). Fields: enabled (false: no retail enemies at all), family switches zombie, skeleton, archer, felguard, alien, dragon, spawner (1.9.9.8 spawner blocks), hell (anything below y -40, hell spawners), distance = {scale, offset, max} (the distance retail picks zombie tiers, skeleton kinds, dragons and spawn pace by: distance * scale + offset, at most max - for a world wider than retail's), regions = {{min = vector, max = vector (x/z box), y_min, y_max, biome (a biome key, mod biomes too), enabled, zombie = ..., tier (a fixed tier distance)}, ...} (later regions win), clear_existing (true: the retail enemies already about that the rules switch off leave, as retail's own give-up sends them, without drops, on every peer; default false: only spawns from now on follow the rules). A spawner block whose waves could only bring switched-off families stays silent (no start, no reward); in one that runs, members of a switched-off family never appear and count as defeated. A joined player spawns no retail enemy until these rules reach it. Never reaches a stock player: server mods only run where none can join.

functions.name: entities.damage
functions.doc: Damages an entity (entity.damaged may cancel it).

functions.name: entities.exists
functions.doc: Whether the entity is still there.

functions.name: entities.find
functions.doc: Finds entities: near = position, radius (default 32), kind (creature key), team, hostile_to (a player or entity: those whose team attacks it), targeting (a player or entity: those after it), state (brain state), alive_only (default true), limit, sort = "distance" (from near).

params.name: options
params.doc: {near, radius, kind, team, hostile_to, targeting, state, limit, sort}

functions.name: entities.get
functions.doc: An entity's state.

returns.doc: {id, kind, position, yaw, health, max_health, name, behaviour, animation, data}.

functions.name: entities.heal
functions.doc: Heals an entity up to its maximum.

functions.name: entities.list
functions.doc: Entities, optionally of one kind and/or near a point.

functions.name: entities.look_at
functions.doc: Turns an entity to face a point, player or entity.

functions.name: entities.move_to
functions.doc: Walks an entity to a point along a found path; entity.arrived fires.

functions.name: entities.remove
functions.doc: Removes an entity (no drops, no death).

functions.name: entities.set_animation
functions.doc: Plays a named animation instead of the automatic one (nil returns to automatic).

functions.name: entities.set_behaviour
functions.doc: Steers an entity: idle, wander, flee, follow, attack, path (to a position), look; nil hands it back to its creature's own behaviour. Options: target (player, entity or position), distance, duration (seconds; 0 = until changed).

functions.name: entities.set_data
functions.doc: Stores script data on an entity (persisted with persistent ones).

functions.name: entities.set_health
functions.doc: Sets an entity's health (0 kills it).

functions.name: entities.set_name
functions.doc: Sets the nametag shown over an entity ("" hides it).

functions.name: entities.spawn
functions.doc: Spawns a creature or NPC. Options: name, health, yaw, persistent (kept in the world's mod data), behaviour, target, data; for AI creatures team and pack (an entity whose pack it joins).

returns.doc: The entity, or nil when the entity limit is reached.

functions.name: entities.teleport
functions.doc: Moves an entity at once.

functions.name: entities.visible
functions.doc: The mod entities this client draws.

returns.doc: {id, entity (the handle lights, models and effects attach to), kind, position, yaw, animation, name, health} entries.

functions.name: events.emit
functions.doc: Fires one of this mod's own events ("<mod id>:<name>") to every mod on this side. Any handler returning false cancels it.

returns.doc: false when a handler cancelled the event

functions.name: events.off
functions.doc: Removes a handler this mod added for the event.

params.name: name
params.doc: an event name, or "<mod id>:<name>" for a mod's own event

params.name: handler
params.doc: called with the event's payload table

returns.doc: true when a handler was removed

functions.name: events.on
functions.doc: Calls `handler(payload)` every time the event fires on this side. A handler of a cancellable event returns false to cancel it.

params.name: name
params.doc: an event name, or "<mod id>:<name>" for a mod's own event

params.name: handler
params.doc: called with the event's payload table

functions.name: events.once
functions.doc: Like events.on, for the next time only.

params.name: name
params.doc: an event name, or "<mod id>:<name>" for a mod's own event

params.name: handler
params.doc: called with the event's payload table

functions.name: fx.builtins
functions.doc: Names of the built-in effect recipes.

functions.name: fx.define
functions.doc: Defines an effect recipe from a table (emitters, lights, shake, flash; the fields of vfx::EffectDesc). Returns its full name "<mod>:<name>".

functions.name: fx.move
functions.doc: Moves a playing effect (streams are laid along the path).

functions.name: fx.spawn
functions.doc: Plays an effect at a position: one of this mod's recipes, "mod:name", or a built-in (fx.builtins()). Options: direction, velocity, scale, intensity, tint, attach, offset. Returns nil in the Original presentation, which has no effects layer. Spawned before a world's first frame, the effect waits for it (up to ten seconds; dropped then if the presentation has no effects layer).

functions.name: fx.stop
functions.doc: Stops an effect emitting; immediate=true also removes what it already emitted.

functions.name: gunfx.clear
functions.doc: Drops this mod's gunfx parts, cues and motion.

functions.name: gunfx.events
functions.doc: Timed cues for a player clip ("GunReload", a variant "PistolReloadEmpty" or "PumpShotgunReload@rpg"): a list of {time= (seconds of your clip, stretched with a reload) or at= (0..1), and one of sound=, show=, hide=, attach= (with bone=), detach= (blend=), drop= (velocity=, spin=, life=), kick= {pitch=, yaw=, roll=, seconds=}; volume=, pitch=, volume_jitter=, pitch_jitter=, who="all"|"self"|"others"}. Options: model= (only with that model in hand), mute= (retail cues not played for it), length=, remote_volume=0.6, remote_distance=24. Your own cues play in first person, other players' at their hands; a clip cut short stops its sounds.

functions.name: gunfx.motion
functions.doc: Turns on MW-style procedural first-person weapon motion: multipliers (1 = default, 0 = off) sway=, bob=, roll=, sprint=, jump=, breathe=, recoil=, switch=, aim_ease= (0..1), aim_damping= (0..1, kept while aimed, 0.3), weight= (heavier = slower), and families={Pistol={...}, LMG={...}, ...} per weapon family. The camera and the aim are untouched; Reduced motion turns it down. nil turns it off.

functions.name: gunfx.parts
functions.doc: Cuts named parts out of a retail held-item model ("ak", "pistol", ...; "classic/ak" or "modern/ak" for one generation), from the player's own installed content, so clips can move them: a list of {name=, box={min=,max=} or boxes={...}, exclude={...}, mesh=, islands=, copy=, model=, pivot=, rotation=, scale=, hidden=}, boxes in the model's own space (barrel along -X, up +Z, right +Y; 1 unit = 1 block). Earlier parts claim triangles first. Nodes named after a part in a clip file animate it. Presentation only.

params.name: parts
params.doc: a list (or map) of part tables

functions.name: input.bind
functions.doc: Gives the action "<mod>.<action>" a default key and a handler run when it is pressed in the world. A key the game uses, or one an earlier mod has, is never taken: the binding is listed as in conflict until the player gives it a key (Options > Controls, or Add-Ons > Add-On Key Bindings). {label=} names it there.

params.name: key
params.doc: the default key ("J", "F6", "Keypad 1"), or nil for none

functions.name: input.key
functions.doc: The key one of this mod's actions has now, or nil.

functions.name: input.unbind
functions.doc: Removes one of this mod's actions.

functions.name: items.define
functions.doc: Defines a mod item. `fallback` (a retail item this game has) is what inventories, saves and stock messages hold; its stack limit caps `stack`. Fields: name, description, fallback, icon, model (a glTF drawn in the hand and on the ground; without one the icon is, as a thin solid sprite), scale (its size there, 1), hold (fallback, item, swing, tool, block, fist, eat or drink: the arm clips and the grip), stack, places (a mod block of the same fallback), cooldown, weapon = {damage, player_damage, reach, cooldown} (melee stats the host checks every swing against; the fallback must be an item that strikes), use = function(player, key, target) (server; runs instead of the fallback's own action; target is item.used's aimed block or nil).

functions.name: items.get
functions.doc: A mod item's definition.

returns.doc: {key, name, description, fallback, icon, model, hold, stack, weapon} or nil (weapon: {damage, player_damage, reach, cooldown} or nil).

functions.name: items.list
functions.doc: Every mod item key.

functions.name: light.attach
functions.doc: Makes a light follow an entity or player: offset in its frame, turned with its yaw unless rotate=false. The light goes dark while the target is gone.

functions.name: light.count
functions.doc: Lights this mod has placed.

functions.name: light.create
functions.doc: Places a light: {position=, color=, intensity=1, radius=8, flicker=0, flicker_speed=9, pulse=0, pulse_speed=1, shape="point"|"spot", direction=, inner_angle=25, outer_angle=40, enabled=true}. Lights terrain, creatures, models and the first-person body in both presentations; a world can hold 4096 (1024 per mod) and the 256 most important in view are drawn.

returns.doc: the light, or nil when the limit is reached

functions.name: light.detach
functions.doc: Stops following; the light stays where it is.

functions.name: light.enable
functions.doc: Switches a light on or off.

functions.name: light.remove
functions.doc: Removes a light.

functions.name: light.set
functions.doc: Changes some fields of a light (the same fields as light.create).

functions.name: log.debug
functions.doc: Writes its arguments, separated by spaces, to the game log at debug level, tagged with the mod's id.

functions.name: log.error
functions.doc: Writes its arguments, separated by spaces, to the game log at error level, tagged with the mod's id.

functions.name: log.info
functions.doc: Writes its arguments, separated by spaces, to the game log at info level, tagged with the mod's id.

functions.name: log.warn
functions.doc: Writes its arguments, separated by spaces, to the game log at warn level, tagged with the mod's id.

functions.name: loot.define
functions.doc: Defines a loot table: {rolls = n or {min, max}, entries = {{item, weight, min, max}}}.

functions.name: loot.drop
functions.doc: Rolls a loot table and drops the result as pickups.

functions.name: loot.enemy
functions.doc: Adds a loot table to what a retail enemy drops when the player this process simulates kills it (retail drops are unchanged).

params.name: enemy
params.doc: zombie, archer, skeleton, felguard, alien, any, or a type id.

functions.name: loot.fill_crate
functions.doc: Rolls a loot table into a crate's empty slots.

functions.name: loot.roll
functions.doc: Rolls a loot table.

functions.name: mod.config.define
functions.doc: Declares a setting the player can change on the mod's settings page. Call it from shared/ so both sides know it.

params.name: spec
params.doc: {type = "boolean"|"integer"|"number"|"string", default = value, label, description, min, max, step, choices = {"a", "b"}}

functions.name: mod.config.get
functions.doc: Reads one of this mod's settings.

functions.name: mod.has
functions.doc: Whether this mod may call an API function here (it exists, runs on this side, and the mod has its capability).

returns.doc: true when calling it would not be refused

functions.name: mod.id
functions.doc: This mod's id.

functions.name: mod.loaded
functions.doc: Whether another mod is loaded and running on this side.

functions.name: mod.side
functions.doc: Where this script runs.

functions.name: mod.version
functions.doc: This mod's version.

functions.name: model.clips
functions.doc: The animation clips of a model file.

functions.name: model.play
functions.doc: Plays one of the model's animation clips from its start.

functions.name: model.remove
functions.doc: Removes a placed model.

functions.name: model.set
functions.doc: Changes a placed model (the options of model.spawn, and position).

functions.name: model.spawn
functions.doc: Places a glTF model ("models/lantern") at a position. Options: yaw, pitch, roll (degrees), scale, tint, animation, loop, speed, visible, attach, offset.

functions.name: music.play
functions.doc: Plays a music track ("music/theme", streamed .ogg or .wav), crossfading from what plays. Options: crossfade=2, volume=1, loop=true. Follows the Music volume.

functions.name: music.stop
functions.doc: Fades the mod music out.

functions.name: net.broadcast
functions.doc: Sends a message to every ready player's `net.on(name, ...)` handler of this mod.

params.name: name
params.doc: Message name (1-64 letters, digits, _ . : - /), private to this mod.

params.name: payload
params.doc: Any value without functions; tables nest up to 8 levels (client) or 16 (host).

functions.name: net.is_ready
functions.doc: Whether the host's initial replicated snapshot has arrived (see the net.ready event).

functions.name: net.local_player
functions.doc: This client's player handle, as the host knows it (nil before the host's welcome).

functions.name: net.off
functions.doc: Removes this mod's handler for `name`.

params.name: name
params.doc: Message name (1-64 letters, digits, _ . : - /), private to this mod.

functions.name: net.on
functions.doc: Handles messages `name` of this mod. On the host the handler is called as fn(player, payload) with the sending player (taken from the connection, never from the payload); on a client as fn(payload). With a schema (field -> "number", "string?", {type="integer", min=0, max=9}, ...), payloads that do not match are dropped and logged before the handler runs. Replaces an earlier handler.

params.name: name
params.doc: Message name (1-64 letters, digits, _ . : - /), private to this mod.

functions.name: net.players
functions.doc: Players whose mod channel is ready, in join order.

functions.name: net.send
functions.doc: Sends a message to the host's `net.on(name, ...)` handler of this mod. Queued and paced under the host's rate limits; returns false when the outgoing queue is full.

params.name: name
params.doc: Message name (1-64 letters, digits, _ . : - /), private to this mod.

params.name: payload
params.doc: Any value without functions; tables nest up to 8 levels (client) or 16 (host).

functions.name: net.send_to
functions.doc: Sends a message to one player's `net.on(name, ...)` handler of this mod.

params.name: name
params.doc: Message name (1-64 letters, digits, _ . : - /), private to this mod.

params.name: payload
params.doc: Any value without functions; tables nest up to 8 levels (client) or 16 (host).

returns.doc: false when the player has no mod channel

functions.name: noise.abs
functions.doc: The absolute value.

functions.name: noise.add
functions.doc: The sum of its arguments (numbers or expressions).

functions.name: noise.billow
functions.doc: Billowy noise in -1..1: rounded bumps and sharp creases (dunes, clouds). Options: scale (blocks per feature, default 64), octaves (1-10, default 4), gain (default 0.5), lacunarity (default 2), seed, three_d (true: varies with Y too), vertical_scale (3D, blocks per feature along Y).

functions.name: noise.cellular
functions.doc: Cellular (Worley) noise. Options: scale, seed, jitter (0..1), three_d, mode: "distance" (to the nearest point, about 0..1), "edge" (0 on cell borders: cracks, plates), "cell" (a random 0..1 per cell: patches).

functions.name: noise.clamp
functions.doc: Limits a value to low..high.

functions.name: noise.curve
functions.doc: Maps a value through points {{input, output}, ...} (increasing inputs; flat outside them), straight between points or, with smooth = true, a smooth spline: terraces, plateaus, cliffs.

params.name: smooth
params.doc: A spline instead of straight segments.

functions.name: noise.distance
functions.doc: Distance from the origin (sqrt(x^2 + z^2)).

functions.name: noise.fbm
functions.doc: Smooth fractal noise in -1..1: hills, plains, climate. Options: scale (blocks per feature, default 64), octaves (1-10, default 4), gain (default 0.5), lacunarity (default 2), seed, three_d (true: varies with Y too), vertical_scale (3D, blocks per feature along Y).

functions.name: noise.lerp
functions.doc: a + (b - a) * t: blends two expressions.

functions.name: noise.max
functions.doc: The largest of its arguments.

functions.name: noise.min
functions.doc: The smallest of its arguments.

functions.name: noise.mul
functions.doc: The product of its arguments.

functions.name: noise.ridged
functions.doc: Ridged noise in 0..1: sharp crests where fbm crosses zero (mountain ridges). Options: scale (blocks per feature, default 64), octaves (1-10, default 4), gain (default 0.5), lacunarity (default 2), seed, three_d (true: varies with Y too), vertical_scale (3D, blocks per feature along Y).

functions.name: noise.sample
functions.doc: Evaluates an expression at a point with this world's seed, natively: the value the generator sees there.

functions.name: noise.select
functions.doc: Chooses between two expressions by a selector: `low` where the selector is under `from`, `high` above `to`, blended between.

functions.name: noise.sub
functions.doc: a - b.

functions.name: noise.x
functions.doc: World X of the point.

functions.name: noise.y
functions.doc: World Y of the point (0 in a 2D expression such as a height).

functions.name: noise.z
functions.doc: World Z of the point.

functions.name: players.broadcast
functions.doc: A system chat line for everyone.

functions.name: players.by_name
functions.doc: The player with a gamer tag.

functions.name: players.clear_inventory
functions.doc: Empties a player's inventory.

functions.name: players.count
functions.doc: How many of an item a player carries (a remote player's last report).

params.name: item
params.doc: Item name, mod key or retail id.

functions.name: players.damage
functions.doc: Damages a player through the game's own damage path.

params.name: source
params.doc: Where it came from (for the indicator).

functions.name: players.get
functions.doc: A player's state.

returns.doc: {name, position, yaw, health, alive, local, in_liquid (the feet are in a liquid block), underwater (the eyes are)}.

functions.name: players.give
functions.doc: Gives a player items (what does not fit is dropped at its feet).

params.name: item
params.doc: Item name, mod key or retail id.

functions.name: players.heal
functions.doc: Heals a player (up to 100).

functions.name: players.health
functions.doc: A player's health (0-100; a remote player's last report).

functions.name: players.held
functions.doc: The stack in a player's hand (the local player only).

functions.name: players.list
functions.doc: Every player in the session.

functions.name: players.me
functions.doc: The player this machine plays: {position (feet), eye, look (view direction), yaw, pitch, health, alive, target = {position, face} of the block the game's selection aims at, liquid (the first liquid cell the look passes within reach), in_liquid, underwater}. nil outside a world. Works for client mods on any server.

returns.doc: The local player's view, or nil.

functions.name: players.message
functions.doc: A system chat line for one player.

functions.name: players.position
functions.doc: A player's feet position.

functions.name: players.set_damage
functions.doc: Inside a player.damaged handler: changes how much damage is applied (0 = none). Works for every player when the host decides health (a session with server mods, or OpenMinerZ players only); otherwise only for the players this server simulates itself, and remote players' damage is reported after the fact.

functions.name: players.set_health
functions.doc: Sets a player's health (0-100).

functions.name: players.take
functions.doc: Takes items from a player.

params.name: item
params.doc: Item name, mod key or retail id.

functions.name: players.teleport
functions.doc: Moves a player.

functions.name: projectiles.define
functions.doc: Defines a projectile creatures (attacks = {x = {projectile = name}}) and scripts launch. Fields: speed (blocks/s), gravity (blocks/s^2 down), lifetime, radius, damage (player health, 100 = full), creature_damage (default damage / 10), homing (degrees/s it turns toward its target), model / texture / scale (drawn along its flight; a glTF, or retail:arrow-style refs where the content exists), fx (a trail effect that follows it), impact_fx (an effect where it lands; with an explosion it stands for the game's own blast), pierce, explosion = {radius, damage, blocks (dig blocks out where the session's rules let monsters break them)}, breaks_blocks (the mod's own choice, whatever the difficulty: the explosion digs, or without one the block struck breaks; never inside spawn protection, decided by the host), on_hit = function(projectile, hit).

functions.name: projectiles.launch
functions.doc: Launches a projectile from a point. `toward` is a position, player or entity it is aimed at (leading a moving creature and arcing for gravity), or use options.velocity. Options: owner (an entity or player: its team's friends are spared and kills are credited), velocity, damage_scale.

returns.doc: The projectile, or nil (at the limit, or nowhere to aim).

functions.name: projectiles.list
functions.doc: Projectiles in flight, optionally within a radius of a point.

functions.name: projectiles.remove
functions.doc: Removes a projectile in flight (no hit).

functions.name: quests.abandon
functions.doc: Drops an active quest.

functions.name: quests.active
functions.doc: A player's active quests.

functions.name: quests.advance
functions.doc: Advances a custom (or any) objective of the current stage.

params.name: objective
params.doc: Objective id (nil: every objective of the stage).

functions.name: quests.complete
functions.doc: Completes a quest now (rewards included).

functions.name: quests.define
functions.doc: Defines a quest: {title, description, stages = {{id, text, objectives = {{type = kill|collect|reach|talk|custom, target, count, position, radius, id, text}}}}, rewards = {items = {{"iron", 5}}}, on_stage = fn(player, quest, stage), on_complete = fn(player, quest), repeatable}.

functions.name: quests.log
functions.doc: The local player's quest log, as replicated.

returns.doc: {id, title, description, stage, completed, objectives = {{text, progress, required, done}}}.

functions.name: quests.start
functions.doc: Gives a player a quest.

returns.doc: False when it is already active or done (and not repeatable).

functions.name: quests.status
functions.doc: A player's progress on a quest.

returns.doc: {id, active, completed, stage, stage_index, objectives = {{id, progress, required, done}}}.

functions.name: recipes.add
functions.doc: Adds a crafting recipe: {result, count, ingredients = {{"iron", 2}, ...} or {iron = 2}, category}. Crafted through the server (recipes.craft, recipes.request, or the crafting screen, which lists it under its result's fallback; at most four ingredients there).

functions.name: recipes.craft
functions.doc: Crafts a mod recipe for a player from what it carries.

functions.name: recipes.list
functions.doc: The mod recipes of this session.

functions.name: recipes.remove
functions.doc: Removes a mod recipe (by id) or switches off the retail recipes that make an item (by name) for this session.

functions.name: recipes.request
functions.doc: Asks the server to craft a mod recipe for the local player.

functions.name: replicated.all
functions.doc: Every key of this mod in one store, as a table.

params.name: scope
params.doc: "world", a player handle, or an entity handle.

functions.name: replicated.clear
functions.doc: Removes every key of this mod from one store.

params.name: scope
params.doc: "world", a player handle, or an entity handle.

functions.name: replicated.get
functions.doc: Reads a replicated value (on a client: the last value the host sent).

params.name: scope
params.doc: "world", a player handle, or an entity handle.

params.name: key
params.doc: Key (1-64 letters, digits, _ . : - /), private to this mod.

functions.name: replicated.off
functions.doc: Stops a replicated.on_change subscription of this mod.

functions.name: replicated.on_change
functions.doc: Calls fn(value, old, key, owner) when one of this mod's replicated values changes (value nil when removed; owner nil for world values). scope is "world", "player", "entity", "any" or one handle; key nil watches every key. On a client it fires for the initial snapshot too.

params.name: key
params.doc: A key, or nil for every key.

functions.name: replicated.set
functions.doc: Sets (nil removes) a host-owned replicated value. World values reach every player, player values only that player unless {public = true}, entity values every interested player. Changes are sent once per tick, highest {priority = "low"|"normal"|"high"|"critical"} first within each player's bandwidth budget. Options stick to the key.

params.name: scope
params.doc: "world", a player handle, or an entity handle.

params.name: key
params.doc: Key (1-64 letters, digits, _ . : - /), private to this mod.

params.name: value
params.doc: Any value without functions (<= 16 KiB encoded).

functions.name: sound.play
functions.doc: Plays a mod sound ("sounds/bell", .ogg or .wav). Options: volume, pitch, loop, position (3D), min_distance=2, max_distance=32, bus="effects"|"ambience", fade_in, attach, offset. Follows the game's volume settings.

functions.name: sound.stop
functions.doc: Stops a sound, fading over `fade` seconds.

functions.name: stats.add
functions.doc: Adds to a player's stat (negative subtracts).

functions.name: stats.define
functions.doc: Defines a per-player stat (hunger, thirst, ...): {min, max, initial, decay (per second toward min; negative refills), persist, public, hud = true or {label, color, icon}}. Stored by the server, replicated to its player.

functions.name: stats.get
functions.doc: A player's stat.

functions.name: stats.list
functions.doc: The defined stat names.

functions.name: stats.mine
functions.doc: The local player's stat, as replicated.

returns.doc: Value, or nil before it arrives.

functions.name: stats.set
functions.doc: Sets a player's stat (clamped to its range).

functions.name: storage.machine.get
functions.doc: Reads a value this mod stored for this computer (client settings and caches).

functions.name: storage.machine.keys
functions.doc: Every key this mod stored for this computer (client settings and caches).

functions.name: storage.machine.set
functions.doc: Stores a value (tables, numbers, text, booleans, vectors) for this computer (client settings and caches); nil deletes it. Saved with the world.

functions.name: storage.player.get
functions.doc: Reads a value this mod stored for one player in this world.

functions.name: storage.player.keys
functions.doc: Every key this mod stored for one player in this world.

functions.name: storage.player.set
functions.doc: Stores a value (tables, numbers, text, booleans, vectors) for one player in this world; nil deletes it. Saved with the world.

functions.name: storage.world.get
functions.doc: Reads a value this mod stored for this world (saved in the world's mods/ folder).

functions.name: storage.world.keys
functions.doc: Every key this mod stored for this world (saved in the world's mods/ folder).

functions.name: storage.world.set
functions.doc: Stores a value (tables, numbers, text, booleans, vectors) for this world (saved in the world's mods/ folder); nil deletes it. Saved with the world.

functions.name: structures.define
functions.doc: Defines a structure from a table: {palette = {["#"] = "rock", ["."] = "air"}, layers = {{"###", "#.#", "###"}, ...} (bottom first; rows run along +Z, characters along +X; space = leave as is), origin = {x, y, z}}.

functions.name: structures.parse
functions.doc: Defines a structure from the text schematic format (a mod file's contents): 'origin x y z', 'palette <char> <block>', 'layer' then rows.

functions.name: structures.place
functions.doc: Builds a structure with its origin at a cell: {rotation = 0/90/180/270 (about Y, +X toward +Z), air = true (whether "air" cells carve), on_done = fn(job, changed)}. The cells are ordinary world edits, spread over ticks.

functions.name: structures.size
functions.doc: A structure's size before rotation.

functions.name: teams.of
functions.doc: A player's or entity's team.

functions.name: teams.relation
functions.doc: How a team treats another (as a creature of `team` with no own lists would).

functions.name: teams.set
functions.doc: Puts a player or an entity in a team ("" restores the default).

functions.name: teams.set_relation
functions.doc: How one team treats another: "hostile" (attacks on sight), "neutral" (only fights back) or "friendly" (never attacks; its projectiles spare them). Both ways unless options.one_way. Players are team "players" unless teams.set gives them another.

functions.name: terrain.active
functions.doc: Whether a mod world generator shapes this session's terrain.

functions.name: terrain.biome
functions.doc: Defines a biome for a world generator (server and core mods, in shared/). Fields: name, like (the retail biome the engine treats it as: sky, water; default classic), height (expression: world Y of the ground), density (3D expression) with overhang (blocks it may move the ground: arches, overhangs, floating islands), surface ({{block, depth}, ...} top down; default grass over 3 dirt), underwater (layers where the ground is below the sea), filler (default rock), fluid (fills open cells under the sea level: ice, surface_lava), caves (false, or {tunnels, scale, threshold, width, y = {min, max}, breach_surface}), ores ({{block, inside, chance, size, spacing, y}}), trees ({{shape = retail|round|cone|column|dead|boulder, chance, height = {min, max}, radius, thick, trunk, leaves, on}}), retail ("world" or a retail biome: reuse retail terrain), and for clients atmosphere (atmosphere.push values) and music (a track or {track, volume}).

functions.name: terrain.biomes
functions.doc: Every biome the session's mods defined (keys).

functions.name: terrain.define
functions.doc: Replaces the world generator (one mod per world; server and core mods, in shared/). Fields: layout = {by = "distance" or an expression, warp (expression added to the distance: ragged band edges), beyond = mirror | repeat | extend (past the last band; default mirror like retail's fold), period (default the last band's `to`), bands = {{to, biome | layout, blend}, ...}}, sea_level (world Y, default 1), spawn = {x, z}, origin_tower (default true), bedrock_depth (0-8, default 3). Biomes are terrain.biome names, "retail" (the whole retail generator) or "retail:classic" ... "retail:descent". Saved worlds remember the generator: a world made without it keeps retail terrain.

functions.name: terrain.info
functions.doc: What the generator makes of a column, without loading it: biome (key), height (world Y of the ground before caves), like (retail biome) and weights ({{biome, weight}} where biomes blend). Nil when retail terrain runs.

functions.name: time.day
functions.doc: The day number, 1 on the first day.

functions.name: time.is_night
functions.doc: Whether it is night (21:00 to 06:00).

functions.name: time.of_day
functions.doc: Time of day, 0..1 from midnight (0.5 is noon).

functions.name: time.set
functions.doc: Sets the time of day (every peer follows the host's clock).

functions.name: timer.after
functions.doc: Calls `callback` once, `seconds` from now.

params.name: seconds
params.doc: delay; server timers count simulation ticks, client timers frames

functions.name: timer.cancel
functions.doc: Stops one of this mod's timers.

returns.doc: true when it was still pending

functions.name: timer.every
functions.doc: Calls `callback` every `seconds` until cancelled.

params.name: seconds
params.doc: delay; server timers count simulation ticks, client timers frames

functions.name: ui.add
functions.doc: Adds a widget (a table, as in a screen's children) to a panel, stack, grid or list; returns it.

functions.name: ui.add_hud
functions.doc: Adds an element to the HUD: a widget table anchored to the screen (anchor="top_left" ... "bottom_right", x=, y= in units of the 1280x720 reference), drawn while the game's HUD is. frame="focus" anchors to the middle 16:9 of a very wide screen; frame="game" to the whole window without the screen margins, where the Classic and Modern HUDs are drawn (to line up with their hearts, tray and gauges). Returns the element.

functions.name: ui.add_menu_entry
functions.doc: Adds a row to the main menu (before Exit), the in-game menu (before Main Menu) or the Add-Ons screen: {menu="main"|"pause"|"addons", label=, description=, on_select=fn}. Returns its id.

functions.name: ui.clear
functions.doc: Removes every widget inside a container.

functions.name: ui.clear_objective
functions.doc: Removes an objective (nil: all of this mod's). Server: ui.clear_objective(player|players|nil, id?).

params.name: player_or_id
params.doc: client: the id; server: the player(s)

functions.name: ui.close
functions.doc: Closes a screen, dialog or HUD element by its root widget (on_close runs).

functions.name: ui.close_dialogue
functions.doc: Closes a dialogue. Client: ui.close_dialogue(id?). Server: ui.close_dialogue(player, id).

params.name: player_or_id
params.doc: client: the id; server: the player(s)

functions.name: ui.colors
functions.doc: The names ui.theme and widget colours accept for the game's inks.

functions.name: ui.find
functions.doc: The widget with this `id` under a root, or nil.

functions.name: ui.focus
functions.doc: Gives a control on the top screen the keyboard and gamepad focus.

params.name: widget
params.doc: a button, toggle, slider or text input

functions.name: ui.get
functions.doc: Reads a widget's value ("value", "checked", "text", "visible", "enabled", "scroll", "bounds", ...).

functions.name: ui.hide_hud
functions.doc: Hides one of the game's HUD elements while this session lasts (never saved).

functions.name: ui.hud_elements
functions.doc: The game's HUD elements by name, each {name=, movable=}.

functions.name: ui.is_open
functions.doc: Whether a screen, dialog or HUD element is still up.

functions.name: ui.language
functions.doc: The player's language code ("en", "de", "pt-br").

functions.name: ui.move_hud
functions.doc: Moves one of the game's HUD elements by (dx, dy) units. Only the Remastered HUD is laid out to move; the Classic and Modern HUDs are exact copies and stay put. Returns whether the current style moves it.

functions.name: ui.objective
functions.doc: Adds or updates a line of the objective tracker. Client: ui.objective(id, text, {progress=0..1, done=}). Server: ui.objective(player|players|nil, id, text, options?).

params.name: player_or_id
params.doc: client: the objective's id; server: the player(s), nil for everyone

params.name: id_or_text
params.doc: client: the text; server: the objective's id

functions.name: ui.open_dialog
functions.doc: Opens a modal dialog. With `root` or `children` it is that content in a dialog panel; with `text` and `buttons = {{text=, on_click=fn, close=true}, ...}` it is a message box whose buttons close it after their handler. {title=, pause=false, on_close=fn}. Returns the root widget.

functions.name: ui.open_journal
functions.doc: Opens the quest journal. Server: ui.open_journal(player|players|nil).

functions.name: ui.open_screen
functions.doc: Opens a full screen over the game (and over the game's own menus). {title=, root=<widget> or children={...}, pause=true, dim=true, closable=true, width=, height=, max_width=1400, on_close=fn, on_back=fn}. A pausing screen stops the world only in single player. Escape / B closes it unless on_back returns false. Returns the root widget.

functions.name: ui.remove
functions.doc: Removes a widget and everything in it.

functions.name: ui.remove_menu_entry
functions.doc: Removes a row ui.add_menu_entry added.

functions.name: ui.reset_theme
functions.doc: Removes everything this mod's ui.theme calls set.

functions.name: ui.set
functions.doc: Changes a widget's properties (text, value, visible, color, ...). Callbacks it replaces are let go.

functions.name: ui.set_journal
functions.doc: Replaces the quest journal: {{id=, title=, text=, state="active"|"done"|"failed", objectives={{text=, done=, progress=}, ...}}, ...}. Server: ui.set_journal(player|players|nil, quests).

params.name: player_or_quests
params.doc: client: the quests; server: the player(s), nil for everyone

functions.name: ui.set_stat
functions.doc: Sets a stat locally (for client-only mods; replicated stats arrive by themselves).

functions.name: ui.show_dialogue
functions.doc: An NPC conversation at the foot of the screen: {id=, speaker=, text=, portrait_item=, choices={{id=, text=}, ...}, pause=true}. Client: each choice may have on_select=fn, or give on_choice=fn(choice_id). Server: ui.show_dialogue(player, dialogue, on_choice?) - the answer comes back as on_choice(player, choice_id) and as the ui.dialogue_choice event (several players: use the event).

params.name: player_or_dialogue
params.doc: client: the dialogue; server: the player(s), nil for everyone

functions.name: ui.show_hud
functions.doc: Shows a HUD element ui.hide_hud hid (the player's own HUD settings still apply).

functions.name: ui.stat_bar
functions.doc: Adds a HUD bar that follows a replicated stat: {stat="survival.hunger", label=, color=, anchor=, x=, y=, width=160, frame=}. ui.set_stat sets a value locally for a client-only mod.

functions.name: ui.style
functions.doc: The interface style in effect: "classic", "modern" or "remastered".

functions.name: ui.text
functions.doc: This mod's string `key` from lang/<language>.lang (falling back to the base language, then English, then the key itself), with {name} / {1} placeholders filled from `args`.

params.name: key
params.doc: a key of the mod's lang files

params.name: args
params.doc: a table or array of values for the placeholders

functions.name: ui.theme

Keys at the top apply to every interface style; `classic`, `modern` and `remastered` sub-tables apply to one. Calls merge into this mod's layer; a mod later in the load order wins.

params.name: theme
params.doc: {colors=, fonts=, images=, cursor=, sounds=, strings=, classic=, modern=, remastered=}

functions.name: ui.title
functions.doc: A large title and subtitle in the middle of the screen. Client: ui.title(title, subtitle?, {fade_in=, stay=, fade_out=}). Server: ui.title(player|players|nil, title, subtitle?, options?).

params.name: player_or_title
params.doc: client: the title; server: the player(s), nil for everyone

params.name: title_or_subtitle
params.doc: client: the subtitle; server: the title

params.name: subtitle_or_options
params.doc: client: {fade_in=, stay=, fade_out=}; server: the subtitle

functions.name: ui.toast
functions.doc: A notice at the right of the HUD. Client: ui.toast(title, text?, {item=, seconds=, color=}). Server: ui.toast(player|players|nil, title, text?, options?) sends it to players.

params.name: player_or_title
params.doc: client: the title; server: the player(s), nil for everyone

params.name: title_or_text
params.doc: client: the text; server: the title

params.name: text_or_options
params.doc: client: {item=, seconds=, color=}; server: the text

functions.name: util.deserialize
functions.doc: Reads text written by util.serialize (or plain JSON) back into a value.

functions.name: util.random
functions.doc: Deterministic random numbers, seeded from the world seed and the mod id: the same world replays the same sequence. random() is in [0, 1), random(n) in 1..n, random(m, n) in m..n.

params.name: m
params.doc: upper bound, or lower bound with n

functions.name: util.serialize
functions.doc: Turns a value into compact JSON text (vectors and nested tables included; functions and handles cannot be serialized).

functions.name: world.biome
functions.doc: The biome of a column.

returns.doc: classic, lagoon, desert, mountain, arctic, descent, or a mod biome key ("mymod:redwood") where a mod world generator runs.

functions.name: world.count_blocks
functions.doc: How many cells in a box hold a block (bounded scan).

functions.name: world.fill
functions.doc: Fills the box between two corners with one block. Large fills are spread over several ticks (a budget per tick); `on_done(job, changed)` runs when it finishes.

functions.name: world.find_blocks
functions.doc: Cells in a box holding a block (bounded scan).

params.name: limit
params.doc: Most cells to return (default 64, at most 4096).

functions.name: world.get_block
functions.doc: The block in a cell: a retail name ("rock", "air") or a mod block key. On a client this is the client's own view of the world.

functions.name: world.light
functions.doc: Sun and torch light of a loaded cell, each 0..1.

returns.doc: {sun, torch} or nil when not loaded.

functions.name: world.pending_edits
functions.doc: Cells still queued by fill/replace/structures.

functions.name: world.raycast
functions.doc: The first non-air cell along a ray.

returns.doc: {position, place (the cell before it), block, distance} or nil.

functions.name: world.replace
functions.doc: Replaces every `find` block in the box with `replacement` (budgeted like fill).

functions.name: world.seed
functions.doc: The world seed.

functions.name: world.set_block
functions.doc: Sets one cell, exactly as a player's edit: every peer sees it, the world save keeps it. A mod block is placed as its retail fallback plus its identity.

params.name: block
params.doc: Block name, mod key, retail id, or "air".

functions.name: world.surface_y
functions.doc: The Y of the highest block in a column that stops a player.

returns.doc: Y, or nil for an empty column.

functions.name: worldgen.enable
functions.doc: Starts offering chunks to worldgen.chunk handlers: each chunk once, the first time a player comes within `radius` chunks (default 14; retail peers see 12). What handlers build is ordinary world edits, so every peer receives it as chunk data.

functions.name: worldgen.random
functions.doc: A repeatable random number in [0, 1) for a chunk (and a salt): the same world gives the same answer every time.

events.name: block.breaking
events.doc: A block is about to be dug out. Return false to keep it.

events.name: block.broken
events.doc: A block was dug out or blasted away.

payload.name: explosion
payload.doc: Blasted by the server's own player.

events.name: block.placed
events.doc: A block was placed.

events.name: block.placing
events.doc: A block is about to be placed. Return false to refuse it.

events.name: chat.message
events.doc: A chat line. Return false to drop it.

events.name: config.changed
events.doc: The player changed one of a mod's settings.

payload.name: mod
payload.doc: the mod that owns the setting

events.name: dialogue.choice
events.doc: A player picked a dialogue choice.

events.name: dialogue.closed
events.doc: A dialogue closed.

events.name: dialogue.opened
events.doc: A dialogue opened (server: for a player; client: for this one).

events.name: effect.ended
events.doc: An effect ended.

events.name: effect.started
events.doc: An effect began.

events.name: enemy.killed
events.doc: A retail enemy was killed.

events.name: enemy.spawned
events.doc: A retail enemy appeared (any player's).

events.name: enemy.spawning
events.doc: The server's own player is about to get a retail enemy. Return false to stop it.

events.name: entity.arrived
events.doc: An entity on a path reached its end.

events.name: entity.attacking
events.doc: A creature's attack or ability reaches its damage moment. Return false to stop the hit (or the shot, or the ability's run).

events.name: entity.damaged
events.doc: An entity is about to be damaged. Return false to cancel.

events.name: entity.died
events.doc: An entity was killed (drops are rolled).

events.name: entity.interacted
events.doc: A player talked to / used an entity. Return false to stop its dialogue opening.

events.name: entity.noticed
events.doc: A creature noticed a player or entity it did not know of (sight).

events.name: entity.phase_changed
events.doc: A boss passed a health threshold (creatures.define{boss = {phases}}).

events.name: entity.spawned
events.doc: An entity appeared.

events.name: entity.spawning
events.doc: A spawn rule is about to spawn creatures. Return false to stop it.

events.name: entity.state_changed
events.doc: A creature's brain switched state.

events.name: entity.target_changed
events.doc: A creature chose a new target (or lost its old one).

payload.name: reason
payload.doc: noticed, threat, damage, lost, fled, leash, script.

events.name: frame
events.doc: One rendered frame on the client.

events.name: item.crafted
events.doc: A player crafted something.

events.name: item.used
events.doc: A player pressed use with an item. Return false to stop the item's own action.

payload.name: target
payload.doc: The block the player aims at: {position, block, face (the empty cell before it), look (view direction), liquid = {position, block} (the first liquid cell the look passes within reach; the aim passes through liquids)}; {look} (and liquid) alone when no block is targeted; nil when unknown.

events.name: mod.loaded
events.doc: Every mod on this side has run its scripts.

payload.name: mods
payload.doc: ids of the mods running here, in load order

events.name: net.player_left
events.doc: A player's mod channel closed.

events.name: net.player_ready
events.doc: A player's mod channel opened: its replicated snapshot is on its way and net.send_to reaches it. Initialise per-player state here.

events.name: net.ready
events.doc: The host's initial replicated snapshot has arrived on this client.

events.name: player.damaged
events.doc: A player is about to take damage. Return false to cancel; call players.set_damage to change it. `remote` true: another peer's player. Where the host decides health (server mods, or OpenMinerZ players only) that is asked first too and both work; in a session that may hold a player of the original game it is reported after the fact and neither works.

events.name: player.died
events.doc: A player died.

events.name: player.joined
events.doc: A player joined the session (or the world opened).

events.name: player.left
events.doc: A player left.

events.name: player.respawned
events.doc: A player respawned.

events.name: player.spawned
events.doc: A player was placed into the world for the first time this session.

events.name: projectile.hit
events.doc: A projectile struck terrain, a player or a creature (decided on the host). Return false to let it fly on through a player or creature without harm (against terrain it just ends).

payload.name: target
payload.doc: Player or entity struck, or nil.

events.name: projectile.launched
events.doc: A projectile was launched.

events.name: quest.abandoned
events.doc: A quest was dropped.

events.name: quest.completed
events.doc: A quest was completed.

events.name: quest.progress
events.doc: An objective advanced.

events.name: quest.stage
events.doc: A quest moved to its next stage.

events.name: quest.started
events.doc: A quest was given.

events.name: quest.updated
events.doc: The local player's quest log changed.

events.name: stat.changed
events.doc: A stat was set (server: by a script, with the player) or the local player's replicated stat changed (client).

events.name: stat.depleted
events.doc: A stat reached its minimum.

events.name: stat.filled
events.doc: A stat reached its maximum.

events.name: tick
events.doc: One fixed simulation step on the server.

events.name: time.new_day
events.doc: A new day began (midnight).

events.name: time.night_started
events.doc: Nightfall (21:00).

events.name: ui.dialogue_choice
events.doc: A player answered a dialogue the server showed them.

events.name: ui.dialogue_closed
events.doc: A player closed a server dialogue without answering.

events.name: ui.screen_closed
events.doc: A screen or dialog this side opened was closed (by the player or ui.close).

events.name: world.edit_done
events.doc: A fill/replace/structure job finished.

events.name: world.loaded
events.doc: The world is ready: blocks, players and storage can be used.

events.name: world.unloading
events.doc: The session is ending (or a developer reload). Storage is saved right after the handlers run.

events.name: worldgen.chunk
events.doc: A chunk is offered for decoration (after worldgen.enable). Build with structures.place / world.*; use `seed` or worldgen.random for repeatable choices.
